description_en: Retrieves the release information of the current client version
description_zh: 获取当前客户端版本的发布信息
name: GetCurrentVersionPublish

AutoUpgrade.description_en:
Indicates whether automatic upgrade is enabled. Valid values:

1: Enabled.
0: Disabled
AutoUpgrade.description_zh:
是否开启自动升级。取值：

1：开启
0：关闭

BigCustomer.description_en:
Indicates whether the current user supports custom upgrades in Security Center. Valid values:
true: Supported.
false: Not supported
BigCustomer.description_zh:
当前用户是否支持云安全中心自定义升级。取值：
true：支持
false：不支持

ForceUpgradeTime.description_en: The timestamp for the forced client upgrade
ForceUpgradeTime.description_zh: 客户端强制升级时间戳

GraySwitchStatus.description_en:
Indicates whether the canary release policy is enabled. Valid values:
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled
GraySwitchStatus.description_zh:
是否开启灰度策略。取值：
1：开启
0：关闭

LatestVersionCreate.description_en: The timestamp when the latest client version was created
LatestVersionCreate.description_zh: 客户端最新版本创建时间戳

LatestVersionDesc.description_en: The description of the latest version

PublishStatus.description_en:
The release status of the current version. Valid values:
0: Not started.
1: Being released.
2: Release completed.
3: Release paused.
4: Forced upgrade in progress
PublishStatus.description_zh:
当前版本的发布状态。
0：未开始
1：发布中
2：发布完成
3：发布暂停
4：强制升级中

UpgradeVersion.description_en: The target version to upgrade to

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
